nodes.label: Request validation
nodes.role: Checks the request in code before any model is called: the intent is not empty, there is at least one non-empty fact, and the tone is one of the allowed values.
nodes.why: Cheap, deterministic failures should never reach a model.

io.out: A valid request, or an error that stops the run.

nodes.failure: Code can only check shape. It cannot tell whether the request is clear enough.
nodes.control: A validation error is raised before the input checker runs.

evidence.text: The messages and rules shown here match the original Python on a grid of test inputs.
evidence.caveat: Checked with the pydantic version recorded in the golden file.

nodes.limitation: Whether a request is clear is decided by a model, not by this stage.

nodes.label: Input checker
nodes.role: A model call that decides whether the request has enough usable information. It returns a status, a canonical intent, the usable facts and, when needed, a clarifying question.

io.out: Ready with a canonical intent and usable facts, or clarify with a question.

nodes.decision: Make clarification a normal outcome of the pipeline.
nodes.failure: It is a model, so it can miss: in one recorded scenario a missing extension length did not trigger a question.
nodes.control: A clarify status returns the question and no email is generated.

evidence.text: Ten scenarios, one run: the gated pipeline asked first in 2 of the 3 scenarios that expected a question.
evidence.caveat: Judge and generator models were not recorded; the result was not reproduced.

nodes.limitation: Not run in this page. Outcomes are recorded, and any edit retires them.

nodes.label: Clarify or generate
nodes.role: On a clarify status the pipeline returns the question and no email. Otherwise the generator writes the email.
nodes.decision: Make clarification a normal outcome of the pipeline.

nodes.label: Evaluation runner
nodes.role: A separate runner sends scenarios through both strategies and scores the results with three judge metrics and structural checks. It is not part of the pipeline.

evidence.text: The committed summary averages are 4.7 for the gated pipeline and 4.2 for the baseline, on a scale of 1 to 5.
evidence.caveat: Ten scenarios, one run; the judge and generator models are not recorded.
